items.rationale: Variance is actual minus budget: 455 - 500 = -45, so the store is 45K below budget.
The variance of -45K divided by the budget of 500K is -0.09, which is -9.0% when multiplied by 100.
A store 9% below budget has a variance of -9, and -9 is not greater than 5. ABS turns it into 9, so shortfalls and overshoots are both measured as distance from budget. ABS does not round or count.
COUNTIF counts the cells equal to Miss. Three of the five flags say Miss, so the answer is 3.
